title: Irene No. 2 shaft headframe behind Triumph Mine tailings (2024)
label: Modern photograph — Irene No. 2 steel headframe in background; foreground tailings belong to Triumph Mine
sourceTitle: Triumph Mine (foreground tailings pile) and Irene Number 2 Mine (structure), Colorado, US.jpg
sourceNote: Photographed 10 October 2024 by Clyde Charles Brown. Original Commons photo 6000x4000; visually inspected original and Wikimedia 1280px resized JPEG. Steel headframe of Irene Number 2 Mine is in middle distance, while foreground tailings are from separate Triumph Mine. Resized without other modification for app and offline image efficiency.
identityEvidence: Creator's original Commons file description explicitly names Irene Number 2 Mine (structure) and Triumph Mine (foreground tailings). Visually inspected actual photo and verified the steel headframe is behind foreground tailings; 2007 Mining History Association field-tour captions and 2017 Friends of Mineralogy Colorado guide independently identify Irene No. 2 steel headframe near Ibex ore house. Do not call foreground tailings Irene's or conflate nearby Ibex/Black Cloud.
